content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301 The associated RTE Implementation Plug-In shall provide a set of Rte_ Rips_StartWrite and Rte_Rips_StopWrite Services for each Data Communi- cation Graph involving a NvBlockSwComponent , if • for the related Data Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled 1078 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11 AND • for the associated RTE Implementation Plug-In the RteRipsGlobal- CopyInstantiationPolicy is set to RTE_RIPS_INSTANTIATION_BY_RTE .
